newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-SICK PIERCE DOUBTFUL FOR THIRD ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SICK PIERCE DOUBTFUL FOR THIRD ROUND.

text.p: Former Australian Open champion Mary Pierce of France is suffering from gastro-enteritis and may be forced to pull out of her French Open third round tie against compatriot Sandrine Testud on Saturday.
The French player, seeded 10, pulled out of a doubles match she was to play on Friday with South African Amanda Coetzer, the pair forfeiting to Conchita Martinez and Patricia Tarabini.
Her agent Gavin Forbes told reporters she had been given injections in bid to overcome the illness.
Pierce won the Australian Open in 1995 and was a beaten finalist in Melbourne earlier this year.
